children: Sud brings over 13 years of experience across premium and luxury consumer brands in EMEA and Asia, including her previous role at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty
Kanika Sud has joined L’Oréal as Commercial Director for E-commerce and Selective Retail channels in the Professional Products Division, based in the UK.

Sud announced her new role on LinkedIn, having been serving in the position since July 2026. At L’Oréal, she will work with the company’s professional haircare brands, including Kérastase, Redken, Matrix and L’Oréal Professionnel, across retail partnerships in the UK.
Before joining L’Oréal, Sud was associated with Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, where she served as Head of Business Development, Project Management and Strategy for over two years.

With more than 13 years of experience in commercial strategy and business growth across premium and luxury consumer brands in EMEA and Asia, she has also worked with Nykaa, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Nirav Modi, Tommy Hilfiger and Hewlett-Packard.
